Your skin could be irritated from too much cleaning and drying. Try scaling it back. For a week try using antibacterial hand soap as a body/face wash, just use a washcloth to gently exfoliate, then use a natural oil to moisturize, like coconut or sesame oil. A while ago somebody posted a question to v/askvoat about strange things you've seen in the wild, I didn't see anything but just wanted to share this strange experience.

Years ago I was hiking with a friend (the hike we did was around 200km) on the Bibbulmun Track. We decided to chill out one day and night hike instead cause we've never done it before.

By the time it was night, my mate didn't want to hike anymore and at this point I'd had 3 coffees and was not gonna sleep that night, I hung around for a while then decided to hike to the next campsite at around 2am.

About 2km down the track I noticed/heard/fealt something "following" me, just off to the side of the track, always on par with me and just outside of torch range. When I was walking I could hear whatever it was moving with me, when I stopped it stopped a second later.

I kept hiking for another 2km with this thing following me until I noped the fuck out and started walking back to camp, whatever it was followed me all the way back.

When I got back to the campsite, I rekindled the fire and stayed awake till dawn when I would start hiking again. I could hear whatever it was moving around the perimeter of the campsite till first light.

8 years later of hiking and I'm still unsure of what it could've been, the closest similar experience I had was when I stumbled across a family of Emu's and the male followed me for 10min during the day.
